name: close
title: The Web gave us the model. Hypertext and hooks let us stop paying it for the same path twice.
html:
The Web gave us the model. Hypertext and hooks let us stop paying it for the same path twice.

Running

Driven by hypertext: only what’s offered now. Found once with a model, replayed with none.

Building

Gated by hooks: Gherkin, red, code, green, commit. No model call to enforce.

Both

Move work from tokens to processes, where it costs nothing to repeat.

Zero tokens to replay. Zero domain code to read. One media type.
say: Building is gated by hooks. Running is driven by hypertext and replayed from kept scripts. Both move work from tokens to processes.
